notes.title: Major Update v0.4.0b3: Shoplifters, Special Collection Toys and many more!
notes.notes:
[h2]🌸 Spring is here, and so is a major update! 🌸[/h2]

Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸 The Spring Sale is in full swing, and we’re celebrating with a huge update packed with exciting new features, gameplay improvements, and surprises for all toy shop owners! From playable Legendary toys to a brand-new vending machine and case-opening system, this update brings fresh ways to expand and personalize your store.

But beware! Rival shops are now sending sneaky shoplifters to steal from you. Stay sharp, catch them in the act, and protect your valuable stock! 🚨

Plus, to make things even better, Toy Shop Simulator is 20% off for a limited time! There’s never been a better time to start your journey as the ultimate toy tycoon! 🚀

[h2]🚀 What's new? [/h2]

[h3]Playable Legendary Special Toys[/h3]
 If there’s one thing more fun than selling toys, it’s playing with them! We heard you, and now certain toys—their Legendary versions—are fully playable! Fly a toy plane around your shop, bounce a basketball, or even make some annoying sounds with a rubber duck! 🏀🐤✈️ Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hk5WKou.gif[/img]

[h3]Say hello to your new Spiral Vending Machine![/h3] 
We've introduced a brand-new vending machine that both customers and the player can interact with! This machine dispenses toys using a spiral mechanism, adding a fun and dynamic twist to shopping. Try your luck and win [b]rare and exclusive toys![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fiuH2Yi.gif[/img]

[h3]Case Opening System[/h3]
We've added five different cases: [i]Basic, Standard, Premium, Elite, and Legendary![/i]
 Each case contains a unique selection of toys with varying drop rates for rare and exclusive items. Perfect for toy collectors looking to expand their collection at great prices! 🎁✨

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JKTsoxr.gif[/img]

[h3]Brand new Special Toy Collector Rack[/h3]
A special rack designed for collectors to showcase their rare and valuable toys. 
Can you collect them all and create the ultimate display of exclusive toys? 🏆

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o4nBh0e.gif[/img]

[h3]Shoplifters [/h3]
Watch out! Toyverse is now sending sneaky shoplifters to steal from your shop. Stay vigilant and catch them before they get away with your valuable toys! 🚨🕵️‍♂️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m5iF3Zh.gif[/img]

[h3]Cash Register Customization [/h3]
From now on, you can customize your cash register’s appearance to match your store’s unique style.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dxiNgI5.gif[/img]

[b]Price Tag Removal[/b] – Now you can remove price tags to adjust your product displays more freely.
[b]New Jammer Car Movement[/b] – Improved movement for the Jammer Car, making it more dynamic and realistic.

🎵 Audio
[list]
[*] Updated SFX for NPC box interaction.
[*] Updated SFX for NPC mop interaction.
[/list]

🧠 AI & NPC Behavior
[list]
[*] Stocker now checks previously dropped boxes to place items back.
[*] Fixed issue where stocker would randomly stock items.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cashier would stop working.
[*] Various customer-related bugs fixed.
[/list]

🛠️ Placement & Decoration
[list]
[*] General placement improvements.
[*] Decoration placing mode adjusted.
[/list]

📦 Environment & UI
[list]
[*] Warehouse racks' colliders adjusted.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the wholesaler product UI text.
[/list]

🚶 Navigation & Collisions
[list]
[*] Customers now keep more distance when walking around racks.
[*] Rack colliders have been adjusted for smoother navigation.
[*] Warehouse racks' colliders adjusted.
[/list]

[h3]🌸 Spring Sale – 20% Off! 🌸 [/h3]
 To celebrate the Spring Sale, Toy Shop Simulator is now 20% off for a limited time! Don’t miss this chance to build your dream toy shop at a discounted price! 🎉

[h3]That’s all for now, Toy Merchants! We’re excited for you to experience these updates and bring your store to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

notes.title: Major Update v0.3.0b7: New Features, Bug Fixes, and Stockers!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸[/h1]

[h2]We’re excited to share a major update for Toy Shop Simulator![/h2]

[h3]In this exciting update for Toy Shop Simulator, we’ve added new features, including the Stocker employee to help manage your shelves, the ability to place toys in boxes, and new visual updates for the Online Order Box. We’ve also made several gameplay improvements, such as better interactions with colliders and the Warm Wheels Set 2 background update. Plus, we’ve fixed key bugs to enhance your overall experience. And stay tuned for more, as we’re adding exclusive collector’s toys and new displays in the next update!

Here’s the full breakdown of what’s new and improved:[/h3]

[h2]🚀 What's new? [/h2]

[h3]Say hello to your new employee Stockers![/h3] 

A new employee type has been added! The Stocker will help you keep your shelves filled, automatically restocking products so you can focus on growing your business. Hire one to streamline your store management!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/E2Ba7OG.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Toys on the floor can now be placed in a box.
[*] Toys in your hand can now be placed in a box.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tL64pAh.gif[/img]

You can now drop boxes in place using the G button.
Visual update: The Online Order box now features new VFX and pink foam for added detail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/e7e1d14b41ffcfdb8aae0d22e20203613bf6dc2d.png[/img]

[h2]⚖️ Features & Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Online order review delete added.
[*] The Warm Wheels Set 2 background has been updated, making it stand out more distinctly from the other sets.
[*] OnlineOrderBox contains toy's scaling and Y-offset adjusted.
[*] WarmWheels name update WarmTires model, texture, and UI updated. 
[*] GameStation decoration unlock level adjusted.
[*] RoombaBot movement area updated and improved.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

In this update, we've fixed several key issues to improve gameplay. From collider improvements to customer notifications, we've worked to enhance your experience and ensure smoother interactions. Here’s a quick overview of the fixes:
[list]
[*] Hanging Rack collider improvement for better interactions.
[*] Warehouse Shelf collider improvement for better interactions.
[*] Scooter shop entry arrow visibility issue fixed.
[*] Tutorial cash register exit issue fixed.
[*] Grandpa Letter issue fixed.
[*] Customer departure time after 21:00 has been adjusted. After level 15, customers will no longer leave the shop.
[*] The logic for "Customer Products Not Found" has been improved. (We will continue monitoring this.)
[*] The product item shelf count and box count data issue in the Wholesaler section (?) icon has been fixed.
[*] The Paint Bucket placing mode no longer appears when placing mode is active and disabled.
[*] The issue with receiving customer notifications at the cash register while being at the register has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]We’ve updated our Credits page! Moving forward, we will be regularly updating it.[/h2]
A huge thank you to our community for your continued support and contributions! Special thanks to our voluntarily translators for helping bring the game to a wider audience. Your hard work means the world to us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/6eee94e9b84abf2587eec041fc20ffc7fa246170.png[/img]

[h2]👉 UPCOMING[/h2]

We're adding exclusive collector’s toys to the game! Additionally, we’re bringing a new shelf to the Boss Room so you can display these special toys. Legendary toys will also become available for in-game use.  (Yes, you can play it!!!!) The next update will be incredibly exciting for collectors and anyone who loves hunting for rare toys!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ngykTm2.gif[/img]

[h3]That’s all for now, Toy Merchants! We’re excited for you to experience these updates and bring your store to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

notes.title: Major Update v0.2.0b3: New Features, Bug Fixes, and Performance Improvements!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸[/h1]

[h2]We’re excited to share a major update for Toy Shop Simulator![/h2]

[h3]This patch brings a host of new features, including a brand-new cashier system, the introduction of the helpful Roomba Bot, and a variety of new NPC models to enhance your shop's atmosphere. Alongside these, we’ve squashed a significant number of critical bugs, improved game performance, and refined several mechanics to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Here’s the full breakdown of what’s new and improved:[/h3]

[h2]🚀 What's new? [/h2]

[h3]Say hello to your new helping hand at the register![/h3] 

The cashier will assist in processing customer purchases, making your shop run more efficiently than ever. Focus on managing your store while the cashier takes care of the sales!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yO9gkjY.gif[/img]

[h3]Meet the Roomba Bot![/h3]

Your shop’s new cleaning companion has arrived! The Roomba Bot tirelessly keeps your store spotless, ensuring a tidy and welcoming environment for your customers. Say goodbye to cleaning hassles and let this trusty robot handle the mess!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YG1yHXZ.gif[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements Are Here![/h3]

We’ve added a variety of Steam achievements to enhance your gameplay experience! Whether you’re managing your store like a pro, unlocking new features, or reaching key milestones, there’s now even more to strive for. Track your progress, show off your accomplishments, and add an extra layer of challenge and fun to your Toy Shop Simulator journey!

[h2]⚖️ General Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rack placement colliders have been adjusted for improved functionality.
[*] Blindman Montecup game level increased from 3 to 6, with gameplay speed adjusted for a more dynamic experience.
[*] Kawaii toys shelf capacity has been increased 6 --> 12 to enhance inventory management.
[*] Cursor size reduced from 20 to 10 for a more user-friendly experience.
[*] Level of Detail (LOD) added to toys to optimize performance.
[*] NPC textures updated for improved visual quality.
[*] Blindman model has been updated with animations.
[*] Balls physics behavior refined for smoother interactions.
[*] Agent behavior logic enhanced to improve NPC performance.
[*] General improvements made to game data handling.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]
